# Ahmed Alvee

> Solutions architect with 8 years across engineering and AI. Took LLM pipelines with guardrails, AI agents and AWS data pipelines from prototype to production, and went live with customers on site. MBA candidate at Rotterdam School of Management (2026 to 2027). AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate. Open to forward-deployed, solutions and AI consulting roles.

This page has an AI agent ("Ask my agent") that answers questions about Ahmed's work from his CV and notes.

## Results

- Data clean-up per submission: improved from about 1 hour to 6 to 10 minutes, with an AI pipeline (LangGraph, Claude via Amazon Bedrock) for 30+ clinics, including human review.
- LLM pipeline accuracy: improved from a first version with at least one wrong attribute in 70% of individual records to 99% of the data submitted to the live database, using Pydantic error feedback, parallel LangGraph stages under a supervisor agent, and customer-specific ChromaDB search. Building the workflow from start to finish took about 2 months.
- Onboarding a new lab and clinic combination: improved from 3-5 days to under 1 day, with a configurable AWS pipeline.

## Experience

- Solutions Architect, Mesh Bio, Singapore (05/2022 to 12/2025). Built an AI clean-up pipeline for 30+ clinics, with human review, and its guardrails (system prompting, a LangGraph supervisor, Pydantic validation). Chose a vision language model for a medical identification pilot and evaluated frontier and open-weight models. Developed prototypes, proofs of concept and MVPs and ran pilots in Indonesia. Built the lab and radiology data pipeline on AWS (Lambda, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, HL7), which improved the time to onboard a new lab and clinic combination from 3-5 days to under 1 day. Owned the integration APIs and led on-site deployment for the first overseas customer. Built and led a team of 3 solutions engineers, hiring, coaching, training and supervising them. Advised customer stakeholders on integration and rollout.
- AI Strategy Consultant, RSM Living Management Project, client Truvalu, Rotterdam (06/2026 to 07/2026). Defined the problem with the client (AI discovery), then designed a 5-stage AI monitoring workflow with a 5-person MBA team, projected to improve monitoring time for an impact investor by about 45%. Built AI tools and agents as proofs of concept and an MVP. Presented AI recommendations to client leadership.
- Software Engineer, Creative Medtech Solutions, Singapore (09/2021 to 04/2022). Imaging annotation and interaction layer for a HIFU cancer-ablation robot, including DICOM export.
- Research Assistant, Singapore University of Technology and Design (02/2018 to 08/2021). Locomotion code for a 12+ robot mapping system. ML pipeline recognizing 7 hand gestures.

## Projects

- LazySplit, own product (02/2026 to now), https://lazysplit.online/. Ahmed got tired of paying for a group and chasing everyone later, especially when the total wasn't an even split, so he made a spreadsheet where people could claim items. That turned into LazySplit, built with Claude Code and Pi: scan a receipt or type it in, share a link, and everyone claims what they had. Joining needs no account or download, and the creator can assign items for anyone who won't open the link.
